title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 79
description: Ten questions on Psalms 79: the nations in God's inheritance, Jerusalem in ruins, and a cry for help for the glory of God's name.

questions.text: What have the nations done to Jerusalem, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "They have laid Jerusalem in heaps."

questions.text: To whom were the dead bodies of God's servants given as food?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they have given the dead bodies of his servants to be food for the birds of the sky.

questions.text: Like what was their blood shed around Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem."

questions.text: What does the speaker say they have become to their neighbors?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "We have become a reproach to our neighbors."

questions.text: Like what does the speaker ask whether God's jealousy will burn?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 asks: "Will your jealousy burn like fire?"

questions.text: On whom does the speaker ask God to pour out his wrath?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you."

answers.text: The poor and the needy ones
The nations that don't know him

questions.text: Whom have the nations devoured, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland."

questions.text: Which question of the nations does the speaker mention in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 asks: "Why should the nations say, 'Where is their God?'"

questions.text: How many times does the speaker ask God to pay back the neighbors into their bosom?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 asks God to pay back to their neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach.

questions.text: How do the people describe themselves in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever."

answers.text: God's people and sheep of his pasture
